rv.q: The Glitch, a shrewdly imaginative and darkly touching speculative drama by Kipp Koenig.
The Glitch never finds its footing in either conception or execution.

cn.t: Critics split on this sci-fi farce about tech-driven parenthood: one finds it a provocative premise with consumer culture commentary, while another deems it an unfunny misfire that fails as both comedy and drama.
